502:t_2:14.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I've heard about $$クロノ$$'s existence, and that the battle over $$ラプラスの箱$$ continues even now.」

502:t_2:15.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Do you know the truth about $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

502:t_2:17.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Why does something that existed in one of the worlds making up $$ＵＣＷ$$ have significance in our current world!?」

502:t_2:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「I thought the same...until I learned its true meaning.」

502:t_2:19.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「What is its true meaning...?」

502:t_2:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「If the Box held only its superficial meaning, we could suppress it even if it were revealed. But...」

502:t_2:21.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... What do you know?」

502:t_2:22.en:
$$リディ$$
「It was because I learned the true meaning hidden in $$ラプラスの箱$$ that I decided to pilot that machine.」

502:t_3:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Are you all right!? If you're alive, answer us!」

502:t_3:10.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「He boarded this ship in his battered $$ガンダム$$ and rushed to my side...」

502:t_3:11.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It's no wonder he's exhausted. Not after everything he did.」

502:t_3:12.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It's just like $$ヒイロ$$ to wait until he'd confirmed the mission was complete.」

502:t_3:13.en:
$$五飛$$
「He's rather cute when he's sleeping like this.」

502:t_3:16.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Heart of Space...is $$ヒイロ$$.」

502:t_3:18.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Those were $$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$'s words.」

502:t_3:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The leader of the colony liberation movement who inspired $$ヒイロ$$'s codename...」

502:t_3:20.en:
$$五飛$$
「Interpretations of the phrase 'Heart of Space' from his speech still differ.」

502:t_3:21.en:
$$カトル$$
「But here's what I think. Someone cares for someone else, their hearts connect, and they can even risk their lives for that bond...」

502:t_3:22.en:
$$カトル$$
「That is what gives humans the strength to live in this vast, cold space.」

502:t_3:23.en:
$$カトル$$
「When we become capable of that, it will mean we have truly become a species that lives in space.」

502:t_3:24.en:
$$キラ$$
「So it's the heart that space asks of humanity...」

502:t_3:25.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I see. Put that way, it makes sense.」

502:t_3:28.en:
$$刹那$$
「I've never seen $$ヒイロ$$ this defenseless before.」

502:t_3:29.en:
$$シン$$
「But even so, $$キラ$$...! Taking pictures is...!」

502:t_3:30.en:
$$キラ$$
「Shouldn't I? It's such a rare sight.」

502:t_3:31.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let's be quiet. We'll wake $$ヒイロ$$ when he's finally getting some sleep.」

502:t_3:34.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We'll tow this ship straight to $$ロンデニオン$$.」

502:t_3:35.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$リリーナ$$... I'm counting on you to look after $$ヒイロ$$ until then.」

502:t_3:38.en:
$$リリーナ$$
(Thank you, $$ヒイロ$$... You understand me... That alone gives me boundless courage.)

502:t_3:39.en:
$$リリーナ$$
(Please rest peacefully for a little while. Then, once you wake, let's move forward together again.)

502:t_3:40.en:
$$リリーナ$$
(We may walk different paths, but our destination is always the same...)

502:t_3:46.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'll say it again. Unlock the $$バンシィ$$'s $$ＮＴ－Ｄシステム$$.」

502:t_3:48.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$ has mastered his machine. I'll do the same.」

502:t_3:49.en:
$$リディ$$
「Besides, the $$バンシィ$$ isn't powerful enough as it is to face $c and capture $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

502:t_3:50.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...I understand... I'll send technicians over immediately.」

502:t_3:51.en:
$$リディ$$
「So just mentioning $$マリーダ$$'s name does the trick.」

502:t_3:52.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$リディ・マーセナス$$... You may have recovered the $$バンシィ$$ as it drifted through space, but...」

502:t_3:53.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I would like you to remember that I was the one who chose you as its pilot.」

502:t_3:54.en:
$$リディ$$
「You weren't the one who chose me.」

502:t_3:55.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then who do you say it was?」

502:t_3:56.en:
$$リディ$$
「The will of space chose me.」

502:t_3:58.en:
$$リディ$$
「That means nothing to someone merely inducted into $$クロノ$$'s lower ranks.」

502:t_3:59.en:
$$リディ$$
「Still, I don't understand. Why are you so obsessed with that $$強化人間$$?」

502:t_3:61.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(If I had to put it into words, perhaps I saw my own life reflected in the fate of a $$強化人間$$, tossed about by others' whims...)

502:t_3:62.en:
$$リディ$$
「...Never mind. I'm counting on you to deal with the $$ＮＴ－Ｄシステム$$ quickly.」

502:t_3:64.en:
$$リディ$$
「Let me confirm one last time. Destroying the $$ユニコーン$$ means killing your half-brother...$$バナージ$$.」

502:t_3:66.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Our path is already stained with blood... In my family...the $$ビスト家$$, relatives keep killing one another.」

502:t_3:67.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「My aunt $$マーサ$$ became so unyielding because her father...our grandfather, was killed by our great-grandfather $$サイアム$$.」

502:t_3:68.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「She seeks revenge against a world ruled by men's logic... As a man, I cannot easily accept that, but...」

502:t_3:69.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「To protect this world, we cannot allow the $$ユニコーン$$ to exist.」

502:t_3:71.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Still, by creating monsters like the $$ユニコーン$$ and $$バンシィ$$, we are probably already standing at the door to ruin...」

502:t_3:72.en:
$$リディ$$
(Just wait, $$バナージ$$... On equal terms, I won't fall behind you.)

502:t_3:73.en:
$$リディ$$
(The next time we meet, I'll settle things with you using the $$バンシィ$$'s true power...)
